scope: Asset-only improvement of Muse for the user's selected R01 homepage. Family card generated/reviewed before hero-right generation.

generation.art_direction: Current delegated art director; backend is not claimed to be astra.

direction_use: Inspected for layout, plush refinement and warm lighting; no R01 UI or character pixels copied.
image_processing: Final generated PNGs copied byte-for-byte with original alpha; Python used only to read image metadata/alpha and write manifest JSON.
review_boundary: Image-level identity/composition/alpha review only; root owns real webpage art acceptance.

generation_attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square transparent Meta Muse family-card illustration.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY IDENTITY: the A02 cream hooded Muse. Image 2 is only a prior pose/material reference to improve, not a mandate to preserve oversized faces or flowers.
Create TWO softly detailed Meta Muse companions in a loving seated cuddle, with the primary cream figure and a smaller dusty-blush pink friend. Main Muse must follow A02: a continuous rounded creamy hood wrapping the small head and flowing into a plump body, distinctly inset warm-peach face surrounded by a thick cream plush rim, tiny simple black eyes, tiny gentle curved smile, short mitten-like arms, and two stubby feet. The face must be clearly enclosed by a hood, not a bare egg-shaped head or a fluffy cloud. No ears, human hair, curls, long arms, fingers or animal features.
Main cream Muse sits on left, about 1.45 times the smaller pink companion's size. Cream Muse cradles a SMALL five-point pale-gold star between its TWO short hands in its lap; hands really touch the sides/bottom of the star. The star emits a restrained warm glow ONLY onto nearby hands, belly and cheeks, never a background halo. Small pink Muse leans shoulder and head against the cream friend from right, looks down toward the star, and rests a short arm near it. Different gentle head angles, tender contact, slightly overlapping rounded feet, nonparallel organic posture. Both faces completely visible and hood rims thick and distinct.
Behind-right, one small pale-sage soft fabric cushion/pod with two small leaf sprouts serves as a PROP, without face, eyes, arms or character identity. No flower bouquet and no book.
Visual quality: exquisitely fine dense soft short fur, delicate fiber direction, creamy warm-white and apricot light, subtle plush contact compression, natural cloth microtexture and sculpted rounded volume. Improve toward polished premium 3D collectible illustration; no long shaggy fur, no plastic face glare, no coarse clay, no harsh shadows or dark shadow clump.
A single compact balanced square group, clear main/secondary hierarchy. Complete contour and all feet/leaf tips, with at least 3% genuinely clear transparent margin on EVERY edge. Approximately 90% canvas occupation. No cropping.
Output genuine RGBA transparency. Outside silhouettes alpha 0. NO background, floor, pedestal, detached cast shadow, drop shadow, backdrop, text, UI, logo or watermark. Star light stays on character surfaces; empty space stays transparent.
generation_attempts.quality_limitation: Right leaf prop left only 0.64% visible-alpha safety border; replaced by one framing correction.

generation_attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent right-side homepage hero group, wide visible silhouette about 1.7:1.
Inputs: Image 1 is the existing ORIGINAL girl/Shiba/Grok hero identity and grouping reference. Image 2 is A02, the required Meta Muse identity. Image 3 is the newly refined Muse material/hood reference; use its cream Muse only, not its pink friend, star or plant.
Create exactly FIVE characters in a polished friendly 3D group: the SAME original warm-brown-haired girl with loose high bun and yellow hoodie from Image 1; a refined cream Meta Muse; the same orange/cream Shiba; a small orange Grok bean; a small teal Grok rounded square.
Muse refinement is the focus: A02 continuous creamy hood enclosing a recessed warm-peach face, thick soft hood rim, simple small black eyes and tiny gentle smile, short mitten arms and two stubby feet, exquisitely fine dense soft fur. Distinct hood/face depth and light, no cloud shape, no bare egg-shaped head, no ears, no human curls. Use the tender precision of the cream Muse in Image 3. Make Muse a BROAD inviting foreground body at left, naturally turned slightly toward the girl, with face completely readable and arms relaxed near its belly. No star or additional props in this hero.
Composition: girl with an appealing large expressive head ABOVE and between the companions, leaning in from the back-center, wink and small peace gesture beside her cheek. One hand gently hugs/touches Muse's shoulder and hood with real contact; fingers natural, no fused hands. Her torso is short and naturally hidden behind companions and the lower edge of their group, not a tall standing body. Maintain original girl's face/hair/clothing identity; do not imitate a different anime character.
Shiba sits foreground-right beside Muse, tongue-out happy smile, pointed ears, distinct muzzle, short plush fur and attached curled tail. Orange bean and teal rounded square are smaller background companions at the far right, peeking behind Shiba without obscuring faces. Each Grok has EXACTLY two WHITE capsule eyes, parallel and slanted in the same backslash direction, NO mouths or limbs.
The whole visible group is WIDE, approximately 1.7 times as wide as tall, with Muse and Shiba providing two substantial side-by-side foreground masses. Girl's large hair/head adds the upper arc but not a narrow tower. Complete character silhouettes inside a landscape canvas, group occupies 90–94% width, with at least 3% clear TRANSPARENT safety margin above all hair, at both sides and below feet. Common baseline, overlapping contact, every face visible.
Lighting/material: warm luminous cream/apricot softness inspired by the selected bright R01 homepage, highly refined hair strands, fur fibers and knit fabric, broad soft upper-left light, mild local occlusion only. Muse should feel softer and more carefully finished than the previous hero.
Output true RGBA transparency. NO floor, ground shadow, pedestal, detached cast shadow, backdrop, background glow, text, UI, logo, watermark, scenery or extra characters.
generation_attempts.quality_limitation: Hair top and feet lacked safe border (visible top0.83%, bottom0.21%). One framing correction follows.

generation_attempts.prompt:

Do not enlarge, squash, alter poses, add characters or change the group shape. The actual character group remains wide about 1.65–1.7:1.
Real RGBA transparency; outside silhouettes alpha 0. No floor, shadow, backdrop, glow, text, logo or UI.

Original girl behind and above companions, big head/wink/peace gesture, other hand genuinely resting on Muse hood/shoulder.

Five separate clear faces, same-direction paired white capsule eyes on Groks, no Grok mouth/limbs.
Hair top and all feet now fully enclosed by transparent safety margins; no extra family star/pink Muse/plant carried over.
